listing.description: Developer preview for compatible OctoSense hosts. Read Gmail through host-managed Google login; keep one editable reply shared by Email, Reply, Chat and native review. An optional account-bound agent can triage new mail into quiet decisions or actionable Glance cards. Includes clearly fictional offline fixtures. Requires the connected-services integration in OctoSense PR #347 and App Hub PR #119; older hosts do not supply these services. macOS testing used real DeepSeek with synthetic Gmail: 33 functional soak cycles and cold restoration passed, with two unresolved instrument frame-submission errors. Live Google login, real Gmail sends and physical send approval remain unverified. Android Google authorization is not implemented. No sending tool is exposed to the agent.
listing.release_notes: 0.1.0 developer-preview packaging of the tested connected Inbox sample. Publisher/support/privacy metadata finalized for ymote; application code, tools, agent guidance, skill and historical screenshots unchanged. Review is required before catalog admission.

listing.description: A macOS development preview using OctoSense shared Google sign-in and Calendar services. Select an account/calendar, view a cached agenda, keep local drafts, and review new or edited events on the host before saving. Explicitly publish an event to Glance with Open Calendar, or ask the read-only assistant about it. Requires OctoSense runtime PR #347 and App Hub PR #119; not a generally available runtime feature. Native macOS journeys used a synthetic Calendar provider; real DeepSeek advisory chat used synthetic events. Live Google sign-in, reads and writes and physical approval remain unverified. Android Google authorization is not implemented for this sample. Recurring series can be viewed but not edited. Screenshots are original captures of synthetic drafts, a standalone missing-service state and the embedded Glance template.
